free_tier.stated: Free is $0 a month with up to 3 members, unlimited member sandboxes on the user's own machines (uncharged on every plan) and 10 concurrent API sandboxes; Amika cloud compute is charged by the second on every plan. The old $50 credit grant is no longer listed.

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: not published: the pricing page prices hosted compute, memory and storage per hour and lists no egress allowance or per-GB overage

interface_detail: SSH, the CLI and the API; a TypeScript SDK (@amika/sdk) and a web UI also exist

limits.value: up to 3 members on Free, with unlimited member sandboxes and 10 concurrent API sandboxes
Team is $100 a month with 3 members included and $30 for each additional member; Scale is $500 a month

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.
